name: CustomerNotes
description: Customer notes by due month (ours): commitments, credit-card payments, cheques with a sales agent, call-backs and free notes
technicalDescription: Our enrichment on the aging report (plan 04.11, part A). A payment promise is a note of type התחייבות לתשלום. One note belongs to one customer + one due month (dueMonth YYYY-MM). The four active types need actionDate and open a grouped task (CollectionQueue, key notes:<type>:<date>:<bookkeeper>) on the date from AgentSettings noteTask.*; any note may have reminderDate. A note closes automatically only when the month's open balance in OpenMovements reaches 0 (status נסגרה – החודש התאפס, closedAt) and stays as history. outcome / amountReceived / amountRemaining / checkedAt are set for commitments by CheckCommitments the day after actionDate, after the receipts run. legacyId is no longer used (the old tables were removed in wave 3). The customer link is the app's first real reference column; customerCode and customerName stay beside it because agents read them.
